summary.match_self_check: PASS: all scoped rows have unique SFA licence IDs; each exact NEX property/postal/unit was checked against the current official NEX food-court directory. No individual tenant identity was established for any blank licence.

withheld.reason: The official directory verifies FOOD JUNCTION as the food-court operator at the shared #04-36/37 premises, but does not identify the individual stall/licensee for this separate SFA licence. The workbook also has multiple named tenant records and multiple blank SFA licences at the same shared premises. Assigning the operator name to a stall-level licence would conflate host food court and licensee; no name update proposed.
withheld.public_access_caveat: NEX is a public shopping mall, but this licence’s precise licensed food stall/tenant identity is unresolved. Existing derived public-access status is not independent evidence that the licence is an independently listed public outlet.
